reason: As someone who remembers the refunds and has already given this month, A answers my real worries: all-or-nothing with full refunds, $11,000 already pledged so only $49,000 is left, spending reports at the library, a Thanksgiving reopening, and an honest caveat about new releases. B leaves a "[Bank name]" placeholder, never says what happens to my money if it falls short, and its "$10 per resident" line feels glib.
